extra.vulnerable_rule: vulnerable = design class P, S or E, or M with m_averages_venues = yes; W, M (not averaging) and U are not vulnerable in the primary count

classes.E: era/period or other championship-level factor contrast, championships nested in its levels
classes.M: championship/venue modelled (M_avg: conclusion averages over venues)

extra.caveat: Counts classify designs, not the truth of findings; the search is not exhaustive and is English-dominant; closed full texts were coded from abstracts or secondary sources.
